description: Labelled UserPromptSubmit prompts for examples/prompt_intent_eval.rs. situation: debugging | design_choice | none. needs_context: false only for turn control with no task content. Tags: keyword (a keyword-table word is present and correct), paraphrase (the intent is present with no keyword-table word), trap (a keyword-table word is present but the label disagrees with it), short (four words or fewer), mixed (turn control plus task content). Hand-written by the same author as the classifier seeds in src/prompt_intent.rs, worded independently of them; not drawn from real sessions.
